summary.zh: 利己主义者会追随更强、更有利益的一方。他们可能快速加入，也可能在局势变化时转向，是高波动但有利用价值的学生倾向。
summary.en: Self-interested students follow whoever appears stronger or more beneficial. They may join quickly, but can shift when conditions change, making them volatile but useful.

items.zh: 利己主义者更关注自身利益和局势强弱。
items.en: Self-interested students care most about personal benefit and power balance.

items.zh: 当玩家阵营强势时，他们可能更愿意靠近组织。
items.en: When the player faction appears strong, they may be more willing to approach it.

items.zh: 当管理层压力上升或组织失势时，他们也可能迅速后退。
items.en: When faculty pressure rises or the organization weakens, they may pull back quickly.

items.zh: 适合在玩家优势明显时快速吸纳。
items.en: Useful to recruit quickly when the player has clear advantage.

items.zh: 可以作为扩张期的人力补充。
items.en: Can serve as manpower during expansion.

items.zh: 他们的加入可能帮助玩家扩大表面影响力。
items.en: Their joining can help increase visible influence.

items.zh: 他们的信任波动较大，不适合作为绝对核心。
items.en: Their trust is volatile, making them unsuitable as absolute core members.

items.zh: 局势变化时，他们可能改变立场。
items.en: They may change sides when the situation changes.

items.zh: 需要用稳定度、资源和成功行动维持他们的信心。
items.en: Stability, resources, and successful actions are needed to maintain their confidence.
